basic_details.job_title: BEL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 17 Deputy Manager, Senior Engineer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), a Navaratna Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence, has invited online applications for 17 posts in its Network & Cyber Security Strategic Business Unit: 16 Deputy Manager (E-IV Grade, fixed tenure of 5 years, pay scale Rs. 60,000-3%-1,80,000) and 1 Senior Engineer (E-III Grade, permanent, pay scale Rs. 50,000-3%-160000, reserved for SC category). Applicants need BE/B.Tech in Computer Science or Electronics & Communication with First Class, a listed certification and relevant industry experience. Online registration is on https://bel-indi

age_limit.details: Category Relaxation OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years SC/ST 5 years PwBD (minimum 40% disability) 10 years, in addition to the relaxation of the categories above Ex-Servicemen As per Govt. guidelines | The relaxation table is printed for the Deputy Manager post. For the Senior Engineer post the notice states the 37-year limit because the post is reserved for SC category, and mentions Ex-Servicemen relaxation as per Govt. guidelines. The notice does not state a minimum age. The discipline-specific eligibility of each post is in the official notification.

how_to_apply: Go to the BEL official website and click the relevant link provided against the advertisement. Registrations in any other format, and applications in hard copy, are not considered.
Fill in the necessary fields in the online format, entering all information correctly, as changes are not permitted after submission.

Pay the application fee through SBI Collect, if not exempted, and enter the SBI Collect Reference No. in the application. The mobile number and email ID given in SBI Collect must match those in the application form.
Upload the fee receipt and the documents listed below, then click Submit.
The filled application form is sent to the registered email ID. Print it.
Carry the printout, 2 recent passport size colour photographs and the relevant documents to the selection centre; its date and place will be intimated later on the registered email ID.

The fee is paid through SBI Collect, online or through an SBI Branch. No cheque, DD or cash is accepted, and fees once paid are not refunded under any circumstances. On the SBI Collect site (www.onlinesbi.com), select State Bank Collect, accept the terms and click Proceed, then select state All India and type PSU – Public Sector Undertaking. Select Bharat Electronics Limited, then the payment category Deputy Manager (E-IV) Post – DM / Senior Engineer (E-III) Post – SE – "Recruitment of DM/SE", and complete the payment.
Degree Marks cards for all semesters/years, and Provisional/Final Degree Certificate
Conversion formula certificate for CGPA to percentage, certified by the University/Institution, wherever applicable

Post-qualification experience certificate(s) from previous to current employer, with joining/appointment and relieving letters. Where a current employment certificate is not produced, the joining/appointment letter, first and latest pay slip and employee ID proof must be attached.
Category/Tribe/Community/Disability/Economic status certificate in the prescribed format, for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates (OBC certificate issued on or after 01.11.2025)
No Objection Certificate, for candidates working in PSUs/Govt./Quasi Government organisations, at the time of application or interview
important_instructions: Details that do not tally with the supporting documents lead to rejection without prior intimation. Failure to upload the indicated enclosures results in disqualification, even if the fee has been paid. Candidates working in PSUs/Government/Quasi Government organisations who cannot produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview will not be considered for interview. A candidate who has litigated with his/her employer in the past must mention it briefly. The Disability Certificate must be strictly in the format available on the BEL website. A request for change of category once declared will not be entertained. Canvassing in any form results in disqualification. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience gives no right to be called for the Written Test or interview, and admission at any stage is provisional. BEL reserves the right to debar any candidate and to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify or alter the recruitment or selection process. Corrigenda and extensions will be hosted on the careers section of the BEL website. BEL charges no fee other than the application fee. For queries, write to [email protected] or call 080-2219 5466 (09.00 am to 04.00 pm, working hours).

content_sections.heading: About BEL
content_sections.text: Bharat Electronics Limited describes itself as a Navaratna and India's premier Professional Electronics Company under the Ministry of Defence. This notice is issued by its Human Resources Division, Network and Cyber Security, from Jalahalli Post, Bengaluru - 560013. It is a public sector recruitment for experienced professionals, and BEL's own employees cannot apply against it.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 17 posts in total. The Senior Engineer post is reserved for the SC category. The number of posts may vary based on the actual requirement at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Deputy Manager (E-IV Grade): Basic Pay scale Rs. 60,000-3%-1,80,000, on a fixed tenure of 5 years, extendable up to two years. Senior Engineer (E-III Grade): Basic Pay scale Rs. 50,000-3%-160000, on permanent basis. Besides Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, 35% of the Basic Pay as perquisites, Performance Related Pay (PRP), Group Insurance, Medical facilities and Provident Fund as per Company rules form part of the remuneration package. Selected candidates are required to travel extensively anywhere in India.

content_sections.heading: BEL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Candidates should have skills in at least one of five domains: SOC Operations; Networking & Security; Server and Storage Management; EMS; Software Development. The notice's job description lists: Security & SOC Operations: monitor and triage security alerts (SIEM), validate true/false positives, execute initial Incident Response and perform Vulnerability Scanning. Network Operations: configure, install and manage core network hardware (Routers, Switches, Firewalls, Load Balancers); implement LAN/WAN/VPN networks and ensure performance monitoring/tuning. Network Security: implement network security measures, including managing Firewall rules, ACLs and IPS, in collaboration with security teams. Create and manage Openshift containers; resolve moderately complex server/storage incidents; assist in server deployment and VM management; manage storage allocations (SAN/NAS); ensure daily backups and file restoration; follow change management procedures. Lead resolution of critical incidents; evaluate and integrate enterprise tools like uCMDB, OBM and NNMi; develop/enforce security policies and compliance; perform Root Cause Analysis; automate routine tasks; design ITSM modules; participate in CAB meetings and prepare executive reports. Development: design, develop, test and maintain software applications; develop and integrate APIs and backend services; work with the DEVOPS team on CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments and container orchestration. Documentation: maintain up-to-date documentation, network diagrams and configuration standards. Candidates should have skills in at least one of three domains: Network & Security Architecture; Server & Storage Management; Cyber Defense & Security Operations. The notice's job description lists: IT Infrastructure Engineering and Security: lead critical incident resolution and deep-dive diagnostics across Network, Security, Server and Storage infrastructure. Architecture & Design: design, architect and integrate new enterprise solutions, focusing on Scalability, High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) for core systems. Cyber Security Operations: develop and enforce security policies/compliance, manage Vulnerability Remediation, define Threat Models/SOC use cases and implement SOAR. Automation & Projects: drive operational efficiency using PowerShell/Infrastructure as Code (IaC); lead major infrastructure projects and participate in CAB. System Administration: hands-on management of Active Directory and overall system maintenance/patching.

Select Bharat Electronics Limited, then the payment category Deputy Manager (E-IV) Post – DM / Senior Engineer (E-III) Post – SE – "Recruitment of DM/SE", and complete the payment. Where a current employment certificate is not produced, the joining/appointment letter, first and latest pay slip and employee ID proof must be attached. Category/Tribe/Community/Disability/Economic status certificate in the prescribed format, for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates (OBC certificate issued on or after 01.11.2025) No Objection Certificate, for candidates working in PSUs/Govt./Quasi Government organisations, at the time of application or interview SBI fee payment receipt (if applicable) Write-up of roles and responsibilities/experience (mandatory)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria are shortlisted by scrutiny of the application and called for a Written Test, followed by an interview. The Written Test centres are Bengaluru and Delhi. The exact date and time will be given in the Admit Card, and candidates must follow the instructions on it. Information on the Written Test and interview is sent by email and published on the BEL website. Based on Written Test score, candidates are shortlisted for interview in order of merit in the ratio of 1:7. The interview is for 15 marks, and its venue will be intimated at a later stage. The minimum qualifying marks are 35% for General/OBC/EWS candidates and 30% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates, in the written test and the interview separately. Outstation candidates called for interview are reimbursed actual travel expenses on production of receipt or other supporting evidence, subject to AC Chair Car / III Tier AC fare, by the shortest route.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 posts: 16 Deputy Manager (E-IV Grade, fixed tenure) and 1 Senior Engineer (E-III Grade, permanent). The number may vary with the actual requirement at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and submission of the application is 08.12.2026. Registration starts on 25.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for BEL Deputy Manager and Senior Engineer?
faq.answer: Both posts need BE/B.Tech in Computer Science / Electronics & Communication with First Class from an AICTE approved college/institute or recognized university, plus at least one listed certification. Experience required: minimum 8 years for Deputy Manager and minimum 4 years for Senior Engineer, as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit as on 01.11.2026 is 36 years for Deputy Manager and 37 years for Senior Engineer. OBC (NCL) get 3 years, SC/ST 5 years and PwBD with 40% disability or more 10 years extra on the Deputy Manager limit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 400/- plus 18% GST for Deputy Manager and Rs. 600/- plus 18% GST for Senior Engineer, paid through SBI Collect. SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for BEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link against the advertisement on https://bel-india.in. Hard copy and any other mode of application are not entertained.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by scrutiny of applications, a Written Test and an interview of 15 marks. Candidates are shortlisted for interview from Written Test scores in the ratio 1:7.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary of BEL Deputy Manager and Senior Engineer?
faq.answer: Deputy Manager gets the pay scale Rs. 60,000-3%-1,80,000 (CTC 20 Lakhs approx.) and Senior Engineer Rs. 50,000-3%-160000 (CTC 17 Lakhs approx.). Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, perquisites of 35% of Basic Pay, PRP, Group Insurance, medical facilities and Provident Fund are part of the package as per Company rules.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Deputy Manager job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the Deputy Manager post is on a fixed tenure of 5 years, extendable up to two years. The Senior Engineer post is on permanent basis.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply for the Senior Engineer post?
faq.answer: The single Senior Engineer post is reserved for the SC category, with an upper age limit of 37 years. Internal candidates of BEL are not eligible to apply.
